 #[cfg(test)]
 mod tests {
     use super::*;
 
     #[test]
     fn ascii_mode_is_ascii_safe() {
         let glyphs = glyphs_for_mode(VisualMode::Ascii);
         let chars = [
             glyphs.star,
             glyphs.star_unexplored,
             glyphs.transit,
             glyphs.warning,
             glyphs.special,
             glyphs.anomaly,
             glyphs.resource,
             glyphs.bullet,
             glyphs.separator_dot,
             glyphs.horizontal_rule,
             glyphs.palette_cursor,
             glyphs.status_error,
             glyphs.status_progress,
             glyphs.status_done,
             glyphs.status_save,
             glyphs.severity_historic,
             glyphs.severity_urgent,
         ];
         assert!(chars.iter().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii()));
     }
 
     #[test]
     fn unicode_mode_uses_non_private_unicode_symbols() {
         let glyphs = glyphs_for_mode(VisualMode::Unicode);
         let chars = [
             glyphs.star,
             glyphs.star_unexplored,
             glyphs.transit,
             glyphs.warning,
             glyphs.special,
             glyphs.anomaly,
             glyphs.resource,
             glyphs.separator_dot,
             glyphs.status_done,
             glyphs.severity_historic,
             glyphs.severity_urgent,
         ];
         assert!(chars.iter().all(|ch| {
             !('\u{e000}'..='\u{f8ff}').contains(ch)
                 && !('\u{f0000}'..='\u{ffffd}').contains(ch)
                 && !('\u{100000}'..='\u{10fffd}').contains(ch)
         }));
     }
 
     #[test]
     fn nerdfont_mode_uses_richer_private_use_icons() {
         let glyphs = glyphs_for_mode(VisualMode::NerdFont);
         assert!(('\u{e000}'..='\u{f8ff}').contains(&glyphs.transit));
         assert!(('\u{e000}'..='\u{f8ff}').contains(&glyphs.status_done));
         assert!(('\u{e000}'..='\u{f8ff}').contains(&glyphs.palette_cursor));
     }
 }

This PR applies Foundation Pass 1 UI primitives to the core navigation loop (`Sector Overview` → `Sector Map` → `System`) to improve readability, selected-target clarity, and 80x24 behavior without changing gameplay state or input semantics.

  - Unified page/panel chrome on all three screens using shared components (`page_block`, `panel_block`, semantic theme styles, shared footer behavior).

92: fn render_sector_map(frame: &mut Frame, area: Rect, game_state: &GameState, app_state: &AppState) {
93:     let palette = Theme::splash_palette();
94:     let block = page_block("Galaxy — Sector Overview")
95:         .title_style(
96:             Style::default()
97:                 .fg(palette.title_primary)
98:                 .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
99:         )
100:         .style(Style::default().bg(lerp_rgb(palette.void_bg, palette.nebula_a, 0.10)));
101: 
102:     let inner = block.inner(area);
103:     frame.render_widget(block, area);
104: 
105:     if inner.width == 0 || inner.height == 0 {
106:         return;
107:     }
108: 
109:     let map_height = inner.height.saturating_sub(1);
110:     let map_area = Rect::new(inner.x, inner.y, inner.width, map_height);
111:     if map_area.width == 0 || map_area.height == 0 {
112:         return;
113:     }
114: 
115:     let viewport = MapViewport::fit_bounds(
116:         ViewportBounds::from_min_max(-560.0, -560.0, 560.0, 560.0),
117:         map_area.width,
118:         map_area.height,
119:     );
120:     let frame_group = if app_state.reduced_motion {
121:         0
122:     } else {
123:         app_state.tick_count / 6
124:     };
125: 
126:     let sector_star_counts = sector_star_counts(game_state);
127:     let sector_fleet_counts = sector_fleet_counts(game_state);
128:     let capital_sectors = capital_sectors(game_state);
129: 
130:     let mut cells = background_cells(game_state, map_area, frame_group, GALAXY_STARFIELD_SALT);
131:     let mut labels = Vec::new();
132: 
133:     for sector in game_state.sectors.values() {
134:         let Some(ScreenPoint { x: sx, y: sy }) =
135:             viewport.world_to_screen_cell(WorldPoint::new(sector.x as f64, sector.y as f64))
136:         else {
137:             continue;
138:         };
139:         let fog = sector_fog_state(game_state, sector.id);
140:         let owner = if matches!(fog, FogState::Unexplored) {
141:             None
142:         } else {
143:             sector_dominant_owner(game_state, sector.id)
144:         };
145: 
146:         if let Some(owner) = owner {
147:             let visual = empire_visual(game_state, owner);
148:             push_halo(
149:                 &mut cells,
150:                 (sx, sy),
151:                 (map_area.width, map_area.height),
152:                 &HaloSpec {
153:                     radius_x: 5,
154:                     radius_y: 2,
155:                     style: Style::default().bg(visual.territory),
156:                     layer: MapLayer::Territory,
157:                     order: 0,
158:                 },
159:             );
160:         }
161: 
162:         match fog {
163:             FogState::Unexplored => push_halo(
164:                 &mut cells,
165:                 (sx, sy),
166:                 (map_area.width, map_area.height),
167:                 &HaloSpec {
168:                     radius_x: 4,
169:                     radius_y: 2,
170:                     style: Theme::fog_style(FogState::Unexplored),
171:                     layer: MapLayer::Fog,
172:                     order: 0,
173:                 },
174:             ),
175:             FogState::Explored => push_halo(
176:                 &mut cells,
177:                 (sx, sy),
178:                 (map_area.width, map_area.height),
179:                 &HaloSpec {
180:                     radius_x: 3,
181:                     radius_y: 1,
182:                     style: Theme::fog_style(FogState::Explored),
183:                     layer: MapLayer::Fog,
184:                     order: 0,
185:                 },
186:             ),
187:             FogState::Visible => {}
188:         }
189:     }
190: 
191:     if app_state.sector_overview.show_inter_sector_lanes {
192:         for lane in &game_state.known_hyperspace_lanes {
193:             let Some(a_star) = game_state.stars.get(&lane.a()) else {
194:                 continue;
195:             };
196:             let Some(b_star) = game_state.stars.get(&lane.b()) else {
197:                 continue;
198:             };
199:             if a_star.sector == b_star.sector {
200:                 continue;
201:             }
202:             let Some(a_sector) = game_state.sectors.get(&a_star.sector) else {
203:                 continue;
204:             };
205:             let Some(b_sector) = game_state.sectors.get(&b_star.sector) else {
206:                 continue;
207:             };
208: 
209:             let highlighted = app_state
210:                 .navigation
211:                 .selected_sector
212:                 .is_some_and(|selected| selected == a_sector.id || selected == b_sector.id);
213:             let glyph = if highlighted { '•' } else { '·' };
214:             let style = if highlighted {
215:                 Theme::border_glow_style()
216:             } else {
217:                 Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)
218:             };
219: 
220:             for ScreenPoint { x, y } in viewport.world_line_to_cells(
221:                 WorldPoint::new(a_sector.x as f64, a_sector.y as f64),
222:                 WorldPoint::new(b_sector.x as f64, b_sector.y as f64),
223:             ) {
224:                 cells.push(CellCommand {
225:                     layer: MapLayer::Route,
226:                     order: 0,
227:                     x,
228:                     y,
229:                     symbol: Some(glyph),
230:                     style,
231:                     protect: 0,
232:                 });
233:             }
234:         }
235:     }
236: 
237:     for sector in game_state.sectors.values() {
238:         let Some(ScreenPoint { x, y }) =
239:             viewport.world_to_screen_cell(WorldPoint::new(sector.x as f64, sector.y as f64))
240:         else {
241:             continue;
242:         };
243: 
244:         let fog = sector_fog_state(game_state, sector.id);
245:         let owner = if matches!(fog, FogState::Unexplored) {
246:             None
247:         } else {
248:             sector_dominant_owner(game_state, sector.id)
249:         };
250:         let is_selected = app_state.navigation.selected_sector == Some(sector.id);
251:         let has_capital = capital_sectors.contains_key(&sector.id);
252:         let show_capital = has_capital && !matches!(fog, FogState::Unexplored);
253:         let fleet_count = sector_fleet_counts
254:             .get(&sector.id)
255:             .copied()
256:             .unwrap_or_default();
257:         let system_count = sector_star_counts
258:             .get(&sector.id)
259:             .copied()
260:             .unwrap_or_default();
261: 
262:         let (symbol, style, protect) = if is_selected {
263:             let pulse_bright = !app_state.reduced_motion
264:                 && (app_state.tick_count / SELECTION_PULSE_PERIOD).is_multiple_of(2);
265:             let style = if pulse_bright {
266:                 Style::default().fg(Theme::accent2()).bg(Theme::accent())
267:             } else {
268:                 Theme::highlight_style()
269:             };
270:             ('◆', style, SELECTED_SECTOR_LABEL_PROTECT)
271:         } else if let Some(owner) = owner {
272:             let visual = empire_visual(game_state, owner);
273:             let mut style = Style::default().fg(visual.color);
274:             if show_capital {
275:                 style = style.add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD);
276:             }
277:             (visual.symbol, style, 8)
278:         } else {
279:             match fog {
280:                 FogState::Visible => ('◉', Style::default().fg(Color::White), 6),
281:                 FogState::Explored => ('◌', Style::default().fg(Color::Gray), 5),
282:                 FogState::Unexplored => ('◌', Theme::muted_style(), 5),
283:             }
284:         };
285: 
286:         cells.push(CellCommand {
287:             layer: MapLayer::Entity,
288:             order: 0,
289:             x,
290:             y,
291:             symbol: Some(symbol),
292:             style,
293:             protect,
294:         });
295: 
296:         if fleet_count > 0 {
297:             let fleet_style = owner
298:                 .map(|empire| empire_visual(game_state, empire).color)
299:                 .map(|color| Style::default().fg(color).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD))
300:                 .unwrap_or_else(Theme::accent_style);
301:             let marker_x = x.saturating_add(1).min(map_area.width.saturating_sub(1));
302:             cells.push(CellCommand {
303:                 layer: MapLayer::Overlay,
304:                 order: 1,
305:                 x: marker_x,
306:                 y,
307:                 symbol: Some(if fleet_count > 1 { '+' } else { '›' }),
308:                 style: fleet_style,
309:                 protect: 3,
310:             });
311:         }
312: 
313:         if show_capital && !is_selected {
314:             let marker_y = y.saturating_sub(1);
315:             cells.push(CellCommand {
316:                 layer: MapLayer::Overlay,
317:                 order: 0,
318:                 x,
319:                 y: marker_y,
320:                 symbol: Some('^'),
321:                 style: Style::default().fg(Color::LightYellow),
322:                 protect: 2,
323:             });
324:         }
325: 
326:         if is_selected || owner.is_some() || show_capital || matches!(fog, FogState::Visible) {
327:             let title = if matches!(fog, FogState::Unexplored) {
328:                 format!("Unknown · {}", system_count)
329:             } else {
330:                 format!("{} · {}", sector.name, system_count)
331:             };
332:             labels.push(LabelCommand {
333:                 text: title,
334:                 anchor: (x, y),
335:                 style: if is_selected {
336:                     Theme::highlight_style()
337:                 } else if let Some(owner) = owner {
338:                     Style::default().fg(empire_visual(game_state, owner).color)
339:                 } else {
340:                     Theme::muted_style()
341:                 },
342:                 priority: if is_selected {
343:                     10
344:                 } else if show_capital {
345:                     8
346:                 } else {
347:                     6
348:                 },
349:                 placements: vec![
350:                     LabelPlacement::Right,
351:                     LabelPlacement::Below,
352:                     LabelPlacement::Left,
353:                 ],
354:             });
355:         }
356:     }
357: 
358:     frame.render_widget(
359:         LayeredMap {
360:             base_style: Theme::default_style(),
361:             cells,
362:             labels,
363:         },
364:         map_area,
365:     );
366: 
367:     if inner.height >= 1 && inner.width >= 10 {
368:         render_map_legend(
369:             frame,
370:             Rect::new(inner.x, inner.y + inner.height - 1, inner.width, 1),
371:         );
372:     }
373: }

393: fn render_sector_details(
394:     frame: &mut Frame,
395:     area: Rect,
396:     game_state: &GameState,
397:     selected_sector: Option<SectorId>,
398: ) {
399:     let block = panel_block("Sector Command Detail", true);
400:     let inner = block.inner(area);
401:     frame.render_widget(block, area);
402:     if inner.width == 0 || inner.height == 0 {
403:         return;
404:     }
405: 
406:     let sector = match selected_sector.and_then(|id| game_state.sectors.get(&id)) {
407:         Some(s) => s,
408:         None => {
409:             let no_selection = Paragraph::new("No sector selected").style(Theme::muted_style());
410:             frame.render_widget(no_selection, inner);
411:             return;
412:         }
413:     };
414: 
415:     let owner = sector_dominant_owner(game_state, sector.id);
416:     let fog = sector_fog_state(game_state, sector.id);
417:     let stars_in_sector: Vec<_> = game_state
418:         .stars
419:         .values()
420:         .filter(|s| s.sector == sector.id)
421:         .collect();
422:     let known_systems = stars_in_sector
423:         .iter()
424:         .filter(|star| game_state.explored_stars.contains(&star.id))
425:         .count();
426:     let colony_count = stars_in_sector
427:         .iter()
428:         .flat_map(|star| star.planets.iter())
429:         .filter(|planet| planet.colony.is_some())
430:         .count();
431:     let fleets_total = game_state
432:         .fleets
433:         .values()
434:         .filter(|fleet| {
435:             game_state
436:                 .stars
437:                 .get(&fleet.location)
438:                 .is_some_and(|star| star.sector == sector.id)
439:         })
440:         .count();
441:     let hostile_fleets = game_state
442:         .fleets
443:         .values()
444:         .filter(|fleet| {
445:             game_state
446:                 .stars
447:                 .get(&fleet.location)
448:                 .is_some_and(|star| star.sector == sector.id)
449:                 && fleet.owner != game_state.player_empire
450:                 && game_state
451:                     .relationship_status(game_state.player_empire, fleet.owner)
452:                     .is_hostile_or_war()
453:         })
454:         .count();
455:     let threat_percent = (hostile_fleets.saturating_mul(THREAT_PER_HOSTILE_FLEET)).min(100) as u8;
456:     let strategic_notes = strategic_notes(fog, owner, colony_count, fleets_total, hostile_fleets);
457:     let owner_text = if matches!(fog, FogState::Unexplored) {
458:         "Unknown".to_string()
459:     } else {
460:         owner
461:             .and_then(|owner_id| {
462:                 game_state.empires.get(&owner_id).map(|empire| {
463:                     format!(
464:                         "{} {}",
465:                         empire_visual(game_state, owner_id).symbol,
466:                         empire.name.as_str()
467:                     )
468:                 })
469:             })
470:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "Unclaimed".to_string())
471:     };
472:     let visibility = match fog {
473:         FogState::Unexplored => "Unexplored",
474:         FogState::Explored => "Explored",
475:         FogState::Visible => "Visible",
476:     };
477: 
478:     let mut lines = vec![
479:         section_heading(format!("Sector Name: {}", sector.name)),
480:         Line::from(""),
481:         Line::from(vec![
482:             Span::styled("Owner: ", Theme::muted_style()),
483:             Span::styled(owner_text, Theme::default_style()),
484:         ]),
485:         Line::from(vec![
486:             Span::styled("Visibility: ", Theme::muted_style()),
487:             Span::raw(visibility),
488:         ]),
489:         Line::from(vec![
490:             Span::styled("Known Systems: ", Theme::muted_style()),
491:             Span::raw(if matches!(fog, FogState::Unexplored) {
492:                 "?".to_string()
493:             } else {
494:                 format!("{known_systems} / {}", stars_in_sector.len())
495:             }),
496:         ]),
497:         Line::from(vec![
498:             Span::styled("Colonies: ", Theme::muted_style()),
499:             Span::raw(if matches!(fog, FogState::Unexplored) {
500:                 "Unknown".to_string()
501:             } else {
502:                 colony_count.to_string()
503:             }),
504:         ]),
505:         Line::from(vec![
506:             Span::styled("Fleet Presence: ", Theme::muted_style()),
507:             Span::raw(if matches!(fog, FogState::Unexplored) {
508:                 "Unknown".to_string()
509:             } else {
510:                 fleets_total.to_string()
511:             }),
512:         ]),
513:         meter_line("Threat", threat_percent, inner.width.saturating_sub(1)),
514:         Line::from(vec![
515:             Span::styled("Strategic Notes: ", Theme::muted_style()),
516:             Span::styled(strategic_notes[0].as_str(), Theme::text_primary_style()),
517:         ]),
518:     ];
519: 
520:     if inner.height > 13 {
521:         lines.push(Line::from(vec![
522:             Span::styled("  ", Theme::muted_style()),
523:             Span::styled(strategic_notes[1].as_str(), Theme::muted_style()),
524:         ]));
525:     }
526: 
527:     if inner.height > 16 {
528:         lines.push(Line::from(vec![
529:             Span::styled("Position: ", Theme::muted_style()),
530:             Span::raw(format!("({}, {})", sector.x, sector.y)),
531:         ]));
532:     }
533: 
534:     frame.render_widget(Paragraph::new(lines).style(Theme::default_style()), inner);
535: }

537: fn strategic_notes(
538:     fog: FogState,
539:     owner: Option<game_core::EmpireId>,
540:     colonies: usize,
541:     fleets: usize,
542:     hostile_fleets: usize,
543: ) -> [String; 2] {
544:     if matches!(fog, FogState::Unexplored) {
545:         return [
546:             "Long-range scans incomplete.".to_string(),
547:             "Send scouts before committing fleets.".to_string(),
548:         ];
549:     }
550:     if hostile_fleets > 0 {
551:         return [
552:             format!("Hostile contacts detected ({hostile_fleets})."),
553:             "Reinforce supply and keep strike groups nearby.".to_string(),
554:         ];
555:     }
556:     if colonies == 0 && owner.is_none() {
557:         return [
558:             "Open frontier sector.".to_string(),
559:             "Candidate for expansion and survey operations.".to_string(),
560:         ];
561:     }
562:     if fleets > 0 {
563:         return [
564:             "Friendly traffic active.".to_string(),
565:             "Use as staging lane for adjacent sectors.".to_string(),
566:         ];
567:     }
568:     [
569:         "Stable command space.".to_string(),
570:         "Monitor lanes and keep scouts rotating.".to_string(),
571:     ]
572: }

574: fn sector_star_counts(game_state: &GameState) -> BTreeMap<SectorId, usize> {
575:     let mut counts = BTreeMap::<SectorId, usize>::new();
576:     for star in game_state.stars.values() {
577:         *counts.entry(star.sector).or_default() += 1;
578:     }
579:     counts
580: }
581: 
582: fn sector_fleet_counts(game_state: &GameState) -> BTreeMap<SectorId, usize> {
583:     let mut counts = BTreeMap::<SectorId, usize>::new();
584:     for fleet in game_state.fleets.values() {
585:         if let Some(star) = game_state.stars.get(&fleet.location) {
586:             *counts.entry(star.sector).or_default() += 1;
587:         }
588:     }
589:     counts
590: }
591: 
592: fn capital_sectors(game_state: &GameState) -> BTreeMap<SectorId, StarId> {
593:     let mut capitals = BTreeMap::new();
594:     for empire in game_state.empires.values() {
595:         if let Some(star) = game_state.stars.get(&empire.home_star) {
596:             capitals.insert(star.sector, empire.home_star);
597:         }
598:     }
599:     capitals
600: }

602: fn background_cells(
603:     game_state: &GameState,
604:     area: Rect,
605:     frame_group: u64,
606:     salt: u64,
607: ) -> Vec<CellCommand> {
608:     let detail = starfield_detail(area);
609:     let mut cells = Vec::new();
610:     for y in 0..area.height {
611:         for x in 0..area.width {
612:             let static_hash = visual_hash(game_state.seed, x, y, 0, salt);
613:             let style = Style::default().bg(Theme::space_bg());
614:             if should_render_star(static_hash, detail) {
615:                 let twinkle_hash = visual_hash(
616:                     game_state.seed,
617:                     x,
618:                     y,
619:                     frame_group,
620:                     salt ^ GALAXY_STARFIELD_TWINKLE_SALT_XOR,
621:                 );
622:                 cells.push(CellCommand {
623:                     layer: MapLayer::Background,
624:                     order: 0,
625:                     x,
626:                     y,
627:                     symbol: Some(detail_star_glyph(static_hash, detail)),
628:                     style: style.fg(star_magnitude_color(static_hash, twinkle_hash)),
629:                     protect: 0,
630:                 });
631:             } else if matches!(detail, DetailLevel::Cinematic | DetailLevel::Standard)
632:                 && static_hash.is_multiple_of(241)
633:             {
634:                 cells.push(CellCommand {
635:                     layer: MapLayer::Background,
636:                     order: 1,
637:                     x,
638:                     y,
639:                     symbol: Some('✶'),
640:                     style: style.fg(Color::Rgb(168, 188, 236)),
641:                     protect: 0,
642:                 });
643:             }
644:         }
645:     }
646:     cells
647: }

326:         if scout_en_route {

352:         if stationary_fleets > 0 {

354:             let marker = if stationary_fleets > 1 {
355:                 glyphs.fleet_stationary_multi
356:             } else {
357:                 glyphs.fleet_stationary_single
358:             };
359:             let fleet_color = owner
360:                 .map(|empire| empire_visual(game_state, empire).color)
361:                 .unwrap_or(Color::LightCyan);
362:             cells.push(CellCommand {
363:                 layer: MapLayer::Overlay,
364:                 order: 2,
365:                 x: marker_x,
366:                 y: y.saturating_add(1).min(map_area.height.saturating_sub(1)),
367:                 symbol: Some(marker),
368:                 style: Style::default().fg(fleet_color),
369:                 protect: 1,
370:             });
371:         }
372: 
373:         if is_selected || owner.is_some() || show_capital || stationary_fleets > 0 {
374:             let label_style = if is_selected {
375:                 Theme::highlight_style()
376:             } else if let Some(owner) = owner {
377:                 Style::default().fg(empire_visual(game_state, owner).color)
378:             } else if matches!(fog, FogState::Visible) {
379:                 Theme::default_style()
380:             } else {
381:                 Theme::muted_style()
382:             };
383:             labels.push(LabelCommand {
384:                 text: if matches!(fog, FogState::Unexplored) {
385:                     "Unknown".to_string()
386:                 } else {
387:                     star.name.clone()
388:                 },
389:                 anchor: (x, y),
390:                 style: label_style,
391:                 priority: if is_selected {
392:                     10
393:                 } else if show_capital {
394:                     9
395:                 } else {
396:                     7
397:                 },
398:                 placements: vec![
399:                     LabelPlacement::Right,

406: 
407:     if !app_state.reduced_motion {

409:         if show_indicator {
410:             render_travelling_fleets(&mut cells, game_state, sector_id, &viewport, &glyphs);

414:     frame.render_widget(

432: /// Render interpolated position indicators for fleets currently travelling within the sector.
433: /// Cosmetic only; simulation state is never mutated.
434: fn render_travelling_fleets(
435:     cells: &mut Vec<CellCommand>,
436:     game_state: &GameState,
437:     sector_id: SectorId,
438:     viewport: &MapViewport,
439:     glyphs: &GlyphSet,
440: ) {
441:     let fleet_indicator_style = Style::default()
442:         .fg(Color::Magenta)
443:         .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD);
444:     let scout_indicator_style = Style::default()
445:         .fg(Color::Yellow)
446:         .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD);
447: 
448:     for mission in game_state.fleet_missions.values() {
449:         let origin = match game_state.stars.get(&mission.origin) {
450:             Some(star) if star.sector == sector_id => star,
451:             _ => continue,
452:         };
453:         let destination = match game_state.stars.get(&mission.destination) {
454:             Some(star) if star.sector == sector_id => star,
455:             _ => continue,
456:         };
457:         if mission.total_duration == 0 {
458:             continue;
459:         }
460:         let elapsed = mission
461:             .total_duration
462:             .saturating_sub(mission.turns_remaining) as f64;
463:         let progress = (elapsed / mission.total_duration as f64).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
464:         let wx = origin.x as f64 + (destination.x as f64 - origin.x as f64) * progress;
465:         let wy = origin.y as f64 + (destination.y as f64 - origin.y as f64) * progress;
466:         if let Some(ScreenPoint { x, y }) = viewport.world_to_screen_cell(WorldPoint::new(wx, wy)) {
467:             cells.push(CellCommand {
468:                 layer: MapLayer::Overlay,
469:                 order: 3,
470:                 x,
471:                 y,
472:                 symbol: Some(glyphs.transit),
473:                 style: fleet_indicator_style,
474:                 protect: 0,
475:             });
476:         }
477:     }
478: 
479:     for mission in game_state.scout_missions.values() {
480:         let origin = match game_state.stars.get(&mission.origin) {
481:             Some(star) if star.sector == sector_id => star,
482:             _ => continue,
483:         };
484:         let destination = match game_state.stars.get(&mission.destination) {
485:             Some(star) if star.sector == sector_id => star,
486:             _ => continue,
487:         };
488:         if mission.total_duration == 0 {
489:             continue;
490:         }
491:         let elapsed = mission
492:             .total_duration
493:             .saturating_sub(mission.turns_remaining) as f64;
494:         let progress = (elapsed / mission.total_duration as f64).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
495:         let wx = origin.x as f64 + (destination.x as f64 - origin.x as f64) * progress;
496:         let wy = origin.y as f64 + (destination.y as f64 - origin.y as f64) * progress;
497:         if let Some(ScreenPoint { x, y }) = viewport.world_to_screen_cell(WorldPoint::new(wx, wy)) {
498:             cells.push(CellCommand {
499:                 layer: MapLayer::Overlay,
500:                 order: 4,
501:                 x,
502:                 y,
503:                 symbol: Some(glyphs.transit),
504:                 style: scout_indicator_style,
505:                 protect: 0,
506:             });
507:         }
508:     }
509: }

772: fn render_known_lanes_in_sector(
773:     cells: &mut Vec<CellCommand>,
774:     game_state: &GameState,
775:     app_state: &AppState,
776:     sector_id: SectorId,
777:     viewport: &MapViewport,
778:     glyphs: &GlyphSet,
779: ) {
780:     let player_has_cartography = game_state
781:         .empires
782:         .get(&game_state.player_empire)
783:         .is_some_and(|empire| {
784:             empire
785:                 .research
786:                 .completed
787:                 .contains(&TechId::HYPERSPACE_CARTOGRAPHY)
788:         });
789: 
790:     let highlighted_lane = app_state.navigation.selected_star.and_then(|destination| {
791:         let origin = game_state
792:             .fleets
793:             .values()
794:             .find(|fleet| {
795:                 fleet.owner == game_state.player_empire
796:                     && !game_state.scout_missions.contains_key(&fleet.id)
797:                     && !game_state.survey_missions.contains_key(&fleet.id)
798:                     && !game_state.fleet_missions.contains_key(&fleet.id)
799:             })
800:             .map(|fleet| fleet.location)?;
801:         if origin == destination {
802:             return None;
803:         }
804:         game_core::HyperspaceLane::new(origin, destination)
805:             .filter(|lane| game_state.known_hyperspace_lanes.contains(lane))
806:             .filter(|_| player_has_cartography)
807:     });
808: 
809:     for lane in &game_state.known_hyperspace_lanes {
810:         let Some(a) = game_state.stars.get(&lane.a()) else {
811:             continue;
812:         };
813:         let Some(b) = game_state.stars.get(&lane.b()) else {
814:             continue;
815:         };
816:         if a.sector != sector_id || b.sector != sector_id {
817:             continue;
818:         }
819: 
820:         let is_highlight = highlighted_lane == Some(*lane);
821:         let style = if is_highlight {
822:             Style::default().fg(Color::LightCyan)
823:         } else {
824:             Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)
825:         };
826:         let glyph = if is_highlight {
827:             glyphs.lane_highlight
828:         } else {
829:             glyphs.lane
830:         };
831:         for ScreenPoint { x, y } in viewport.world_line_to_cells(
832:             WorldPoint::new(a.x as f64, a.y as f64),
833:             WorldPoint::new(b.x as f64, b.y as f64),
834:         ) {
835:             cells.push(CellCommand {
836:                 layer: MapLayer::Route,
837:                 order: 0,
838:                 x,
839:                 y,
840:                 symbol: Some(glyph),
841:                 style,
842:                 protect: 0,
843:             });
844:         }
845:     }
846: }

848: fn fleets_at_star(game_state: &GameState, sector_id: SectorId) -> BTreeMap<StarId, usize> {
849:     let mut fleets = BTreeMap::<StarId, usize>::new();
850:     for fleet in game_state.fleets.values() {
851:         let Some(star) = game_state.stars.get(&fleet.location) else {
852:             continue;
853:         };
854:         if star.sector == sector_id {
855:             *fleets.entry(fleet.location).or_default() += 1;
856:         }
857:     }
858:     fleets
859: }

861: fn background_cells(
862:     game_state: &GameState,

867:     let detail = starfield_detail(area);

869:     for y in 0..area.height {

875:                     game_state.seed,

877:                     y,
878:                     frame_group,
879:                     salt ^ SECTOR_STARFIELD_TWINKLE_SALT_XOR,

881:                 cells.push(CellCommand {

884:                     x,

890:             } else if matches!(detail, DetailLevel::Cinematic | DetailLevel::Standard)

899:                     style: style.fg(Color::Rgb(168, 188, 236)),
900:                     protect: 0,
901:                 });
902:             }
903:         }
904:     }
905:     cells

parts.text:
For Fix 2, I need to gate the hostile_fleets count so it only counts when the sector is Visible. Looking at the code:

```rust
    let hostile_fleets = game_state
        .fleets
        .values()
        .filter(|fleet| {
            game_state
                .stars
                .get(&fleet.location)
                .is_some_and(|star| star.sector == sector.id)
                && fleet.owner != game_state.player_empire
                && game_state
                    .relationship_status(game_state.player_empire, fleet.owner)
                    .is_hostile_or_war()
        })
        .count();
```

And `fog` is already computed above. The fix is to gate this on `fog == Visible`. If the sector is not visible, the player shouldn't know about hostile fleets.

The simplest approach: only count hostile fleets when the sector is visible. Otherwise, set to 0.

Actually, let me think about this more carefully. The `FogState::Unexplored` means the player has never explored any star in the sector - they really shouldn't see hostile fleet info. For `FogState::Explored`, the player has explored at least one star in the sector but doesn't have current visibility. In this case, the player might know about some fleets but not all.

The PR comment says: "Consider restricting the hostile-fleet count to fleets the player can actually observe (e.g. using `visible_star_ids`/`star_fog_state`) or suppressing the threat meter / hostile note when the sector is not `Visible`."

I'll take the simpler approach: suppress the hostile count when the sector is not `Visible`. This aligns with the fog-of-war principle.

        .checked_div(total)
        .map(|pct| pct.min(100) as u8)
        .unwrap_or(0)
